question: The claims of the patients or their relatives that are received in the User Care Units are an indicator of quality, but what quality component do they measure?

options.opa: The quality of the attention of the Customer Service Unit.
options.opc: The quality of the treatment of patients in terms of adherence to the guidelines of Good Clinical Practice.

analysis: The claims of patients or their relatives received in the User Care Units typically measure the extrinsic or perceived quality of the healthcare services provided.
